title: Revenue Sum, Exact
description: Revenue is tracked in whole cents everywhere in SwiftCargo — a bucketed report's revenue figures should add up to the exact same integer a plain SQL SUM would produce, with zero floating-point drift creeping in anywhere along the way.
successCondition: Book at least 5 shipments with varied, deliberately "awkward" priceCents values (not round numbers) within a known date range. GET /api/reporting/summary for that range. Querying `select sum(price_cents) from shipments where created_at >= '<from>' and created_at < '<to>'` via `npm run db:psql` confirms it exactly equals the API response's totalRevenueCents, AND that summing every individual bucket's revenueCents in the response also exactly equals that same total — bucketing the data across multiple day/month buckets never loses or double-counts a single cent.
hints: priceCents/amountCents are always integers throughout the schema (Int columns, not Float) — there should be no rounding involved in a straight SUM, making an exact match the correct expectation, not just a "close enough" one.
Use groupBy=day with a date range spanning several distinct days so the bucketing logic actually has to split the data across multiple buckets, rather than lumping everything into one.
